run_free_hallucination: run free_hallucination to generate a ProgramNode for protein design with a given sequence length
create_program_node: create a ProgramNode with a fixed-length sequence segment and energy optimization terms using free_hallucination
maximize_protein_quality: use free_hallucination to build a protein design program that maximizes PTM and pLDDT scores
minimize_surface_hydrophobics: use free_hallucination to create a protein design program that minimizes surface hydrophobic residues
review_free_hallucination: review the free_hallucination function to understand its energy function terms for protein design
